technicalFacts.text: Use two thin coats, with 24 hours before the second coat. Cure time is 24–48 hours at 70°F and 50% RH. Ground and air temperature is 40°F and rising; 55°F or higher is preferred. Keep rain absent for 36 hours. Container size is 4.75 US gallons.

Apply one coat only. Minimum application temperature is 50°F and rising. Avoid rain, frost or temperatures below 50°F for 48 hours. Dry to touch in 4 hours; vehicle use after 24–48 hours under normal conditions. New asphalt needs at least 6 months before application.

SKU 262245 comes in a 3.5 US gallon pail. Apply at 50–90°F air, material and surface temperature, with surface below 100°F and no rain for 48 hours. At 70°F and 50% RH, foot traffic is ready after 1 hour and vehicle traffic after 4 hours. Poor asphalt uses 2 coats. An exact recoat interval is not listed.

For 100 gallons of concentrate, the listed mix uses 15–25 gallons of water, 2 gallons of TopTuff and 300–500 lb of sand. Apply two coats, with 2–4 hours between them and 24 hours before traffic. Keep temperature above 50°F during application and the next 24 hours. Sizes include 5 gallon pails and 55 gallon drums.

This factory blend includes water, aggregate and polymer. Apply at least two coats; each coat dries before the next. Wait 24 hours after the final coat before vehicle traffic. Maintain temperature above 50°F during application and the next 24 hours.

A 50 lb bag yields about 0.5 ft³ compacted; a 60 lb bag yields about 0.6 ft³. The product repairs potholes and cracks over 1 inch wide. Apply 1–3 inches total, in adequately compacted 1 inch lifts, with at least 1 inch thickness. Limit repairs to about 3 × 3 ft. Traffic begins after satisfactory leveling and compaction.

The linked TDS limits repairs to 2 × 2 ft and 4 inches deep. Place 2 inch loose layers and compact each to 1 inch, repeating to the finished depth. Open to traffic after thorough compaction. The extracted sealer wait time is incomplete; verify the label before using that figure.

Latex-ite 2X is a cold applied product for asphalt cracks up to 1/2 inch wide. Clear debris, shake the bottle and apply from the spout. Its manufacturer page does not give a verified linear-foot yield, so keep yield custom.

SealMaster Acrylic Crack Filler comes in a 1 US gallon jug. Do not dilute. Maintain at least 50°F and rising, without a temperature drop below 50°F or rain during the next 24 hours. Open to traffic only after material dries.

SKU 250700 contains 10 lb of powder. For patch use, mix with 16 fl oz water; for crack filling, use 20 fl oz water. Ordinary patch depth is at most 1 inch, and cracks at most 1/2 inch wide. Apply at 40–90°F with no rain for 24 hours. Normal traffic begins after 24 hours; cooler conditions take longer.

A driveway channel drain captures surface runoff and carries it to a suitable outlet. System capacity depends on runoff volume, rainfall, and soil conditions.
